Petition filed under under Section 11 of the Contempt of Court 
 1971, to punish the contemnor for wilfully disobeying and not complying
 the order of this Court, dated 26.02.2025, in W.P.(MD)No.3758 of 2025.
 For Petitioner : Mr.T.Veerakum

 Order
It is submitted that writ appeal is preferred against the order passed by this Court and an interim order is passed in the writ appeal.
2.Recording the said submission, the contempt petition is closed.
